subject: Prefetch data from web API in separate tabs

messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Prefetch data from web API in separate tabs
parts:
Hello, 

I asked a similar question a while back: https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!searchin/shiny-discuss/tab$20data/shiny-discuss/pEogZmy-FSw/gO2l02iiH3UJ. 

I have an app (app: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/ropensci/usgs_app_sandbox/, code: https://github.com/ropensci/usgs_app/tree/ramnath) that pulls data from various web APIs for each tab based on user input in the sidebar. If the input in the sidebar is updated, new API calls are made. 

My question is, What is the fastest way to prepare data on server side in all tabs (beyond just the one user is focused on)?  It seems that when going to a new tab in my app all the work has to be done to get the data for that tab. Could this work be done in the background so that when someone hits a tab the data will be ready, without slowing down the app overall?

I'm using Shiny v.0.6 in R 3.01 patched on OSX. 

Thanks! Scott

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Re: Prefetch data from web API in separate tabs
parts:
Okay, i've assembled a working demo, which downloads any number of urls in parallel and creates an output.

It's not quite your use case, but it you save the fetcher in a variable in the server function you can depend upon it's completed value from your output function for each tab.

be sure to install the updated httr - it won't break existing functionality.

https://github.com/alexbbrown/mURL

-Alex
